about: Place names the player is told (ink UI round, gen/ui/STYLE.md 'Place notifications'). region: the large banner shown when you walk into this section's region (sections sharing a region id show it once). landmarks: a vertical name plaque stands over the map entity id as you approach (江南百景圖's plaques), and a toast with the line from the painting's reading when you come within r metres of its footprint (or its point); top: the plaque's height when the map has none. Every name and line in 繁體, from the painting and its readings; src says where. Lore (round 2, gen/ui/r2_lore.md): long is the longer description under the toast's fold and in the 圖志 journal; quote and quoteSrc an exact line from a period or scholarly source; cite the sources as the player reads them; longSrc one note per claim (never shown); crop the map IDs that frame the painting's crop (tools/place_crops.mjs). Bundled for the page by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/places.json (short) and lore.json (long, fetched when needed). Every displayed field has an English sibling `<field>_en`, shown as a gloss under the Chinese when the viewer picks 中英 (Chinese stays the default).

region.name: 城門口外
region.src: S4 part 2: the same region as outer_road (one 余辉 segment), so crossing between them shows no banner

landmarks.name: 大棕蓋車
landmarks.line: 富戶人家的車，棕葉蓋頂。
landmarks.line_en: A rich family's cart, roofed with palm fibre.
landmarks.src: 名画记 27 大棕盖车; 余辉 2014 豪车云集
landmarks.long: 路口一停一走兩輛大車，車頂鋪著厚厚的棕毛，像一座蓬鬆的草屋。這是給家眷坐的車子，《東京夢華錄》叫它「宅眷坐車子」。故宮名畫記看見走著的那輛車後門裏，一位婦人低頭撩起簾子往外望；車前一牛駕轅、一牛拉套，後面跟著提食物的僕從，騎馬戴帽的大概就是男主人，一行人也許剛從郊外掃墓回來。
landmarks.long_en: At the junction, two big carts, one halted and one moving, have thick palm fibre spread over their roofs like fluffy thatched huts. These are carts for a family's women, called “carts for household ladies” in Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital. The Palace Museum's notes see, in the rear door of the cart that is moving, a lady lowering her head to lift the curtain and look out; an ox is in the shafts and another is hitched on, servants follow behind carrying food, and the capped rider is probably the master of the house, the party perhaps just back from sweeping graves in the country.
landmarks.quote: 又有宅眷坐車子，與平頭車大抵相似，但棕作蓋。
landmarks.quote_en: There are also carts for household ladies, much like flat-topped carts, but with a palm-fibre cover.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・《東京夢華錄》・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · What the painting shows
longSrc: map S4b.veh.palm_cart_13070 (parked, unhitched), S4b.veh.palm_cart_13455 (shaft ox and lead ox)
MHJ 27: 一停一走两辆大棕盖车…专供家眷坐的车子…一个妇女低着头撩起门帘正往外看…一头牛驾辕，一头牛拉套…两个仆从携带着食品…应该是这家男主人…也许是从郊外扫墓回来的
quote: DJ 卷三 般载杂卖

landmarks.name: 車鋪
landmarks.line_en: A craftsman mends a big cart's wheel.
landmarks.src: 名画记 26 大车修理店; 余辉 2014 车铺劳作
landmarks.long: 小飯鋪北邊是一家修大車的鋪子，棚下堆著方木、長桿，大概是做車轅、車軸的料。一個匠人彎著腰，伏在一隻平放在地上的大車輪上幹活；故宮名畫記說他雙手握著榔頭，正在修整車輪。城門口外，牛車、棕蓋車往來不絕。余輝為這一景取名「車鋪勞作」。
landmarks.long_en: North of the small eating shop is a shop that repairs big carts, with squared timbers and long poles piled under its awning, probably material for making shafts and axles. A craftsman bends over a big cart wheel laid flat on the ground at his work; the Palace Museum's notes say he grips a mallet in both hands and is trimming the wheel. Outside the city gate, ox carts and palm-roofed carts come and go without end. Yu Hui names this scene “Work at the Cartwright's.”
landmarks.quote: 東京般載車，大者曰『太平』。
landmarks.quote_en: The goods-carrying carts of the Eastern Capital: the largest is called the “Taiping.”
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・余輝・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 26: 一个小饭铺的北边，是一家大车修理店，门口堆积了许多木料，一个工人双手持着榔头，正在修整车轮

landmarks.name: 小鋪閒坐
landmarks.name_en: The Little Shop Where People Sit
landmarks.line: 路邊小鋪，有人閒坐吃茶。
landmarks.line_en: A roadside shop; someone sits over tea.
landmarks.src: 余辉 2014 vignette 小铺闲坐 (the map's tea house; its identification marked uncertain)
landmarks.long: 路北一座敞開的廳堂，前頭搭著蓆棚，棚下擺著長桌條凳。一位戴寬簷黑帽的客人探身向前，和對面一個翹著腿的白衣胖漢說話；另一位戴黑帽的，兩肘支在桌上歇著。屋上不見招牌，是不是茶鋪，還說不準；余輝為這一景取名「小鋪閒坐」。城門口外這一段，處處是這樣不慌不忙的人。
landmarks.long_en: On the north side of the road is an open hall with a mat awning in front, long tables and benches set out beneath it. A guest in a wide-brimmed black hat leans forward to talk to a stout man in white sitting opposite with his legs crossed; another man in a black hat rests with both elbows on the table. There is no sign on the roof, so whether it is a teahouse is not certain; Yu Hui names this scene “Sitting at the Little Shop.” This stretch outside the city gate is full of unhurried people like these.
landmarks.quote: 更有提茶瓶之人，每日鄰里互相支茶，相問動靜。
landmarks.quote_en: There are also those who carry teapots, and every day neighbours set out tea for each other and ask after one another's news.
landmarks.cite: 余輝・《東京夢華錄》・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Yu Hui · Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · What the painting shows
